texts.text:
我是不是哪里得罪你们了？拜托，我道歉。别伤我！
 Did I offend you or something? Please, I'm sorry. Don't hurt me!
texts.speaker:
杜布瓦
 Dubois

texts.text:
……！你们是顾客，还是亵渎者？！
 ...! Are you customers, or blasphemers?!
texts.speaker:
居斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
你们是来杀我、从我血肉里刮走黄金松脂的吗？！
 Are you here to kill me and scrape the Golden Resin from my flesh?!
texts.speaker:
居斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
有什么问题吗？是我的品牌不合您的心意？
 What is the issue? Do you not find my label to your liking?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
用血染衣服？这种时尚追求未免太过时了吧？真俗气。
 Dyeing clothing with blood? That's a rather outmoded fashion to pursue, isn't it? How tacky.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
它的金光已彻底黯淡。剩下的只是一堆正缓缓向内塌陷的尸体。
 Its golden light has completely faded. What remains is a pile of bodies slowly caving in on itself.

大部分书页浸满了血，很难辨认写了什么。
 Most pages are soaked in blood and difficult to tell what it says.

我将念出仍可辨读的部分。
 I will read out loud what is legible.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
“该死——你他妈——婊——搞得好像站上——台是什么了不得的大事……”
 "Godda— —otherfu— —tch—like it's some great undertaking to —ing on the —unway..."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
“狂妄的小——新——，才刚爬上来就给我认清自己的位——”
 "Cockly little— —eenhorn, know your place if you've just climbed up he—"
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
默尔索翻过了几页浸血太多、无法辨读的纸。
 Meursault flipped past a few pages that have soaked up far too much blood to be legible.
“可憎的——小杂种。我就知道。我早知道像他们那样的——不可能靠自己走到这——步。 "Abhorre— —tle shit. I knew it. I knew a— —like them couldn't have made it thi— —ar on their own.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
“——可悲的水蛭，跟红——勾结，把整座百——的——全都吸干。”
 "—thetic leech, working with Le— to— suck up all the— —of the— —artment store."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
“我要当着所有——的面，让他们丢尽——脸。”
 "I'm goi— to embarrass the— —hit out of them in— —of everyone."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……这家百货不管爬到多高，每一层都是这副样子啊。>
 <... This department store's like this through all the floors no matter how high you climb, huh?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这里本来写着什么，现在已经没了。这本日记浸的血太多。
 There was something written in here, but it's gone now. The journal has soaked up too much blood.

<……可恶，我们分神的时候被它得手了。>
 <... Damn, it got us while we were distracted.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
不过它挺慢的。而且也没多强。
 It was pretty slow, though. And not even that strong.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
试试吧。只要不大意，我觉得默尔索对付它不难。
 Let's try. I don't think Meursault'll have a hard time fighting it unless he lets his guard down.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
唔。
 Mm.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text: <它的出招我明明已经知道了……> know its patterns...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<……抱歉。我的指示慢了。你没事吧，默尔索？>
 <... Sorry. My instructions were late. Are you okay, Meursault?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
没有问题。
 There is no issue.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
*叹气* 好吧，这算是学了一课。它一颤抖，就当是它在蓄力冲撞的警告。
 *sigh* Well, that's a lesson learned. When it trembles, take it as a warning that it's winding up to charge.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 那东西是真能窜啊？从另一头一路冲过来……这到底要怎么躲啊……？ That thing can really zoom, huh? Like, all the way from the other end... How the heck are you supposed to dodge that...?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<听到声音，就朝声源的垂直方向往左或往右挪。>
 <When you hear the sound, just move left or right perpendicular to its origin.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<这样躲开应该不难。要不然也可以趁它动起来之前直接宰了它。>
 <Shouldn't be too hard to avoid them, then. Or we could also just kill it before it has a chance to move.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
皮肤烫卷用的加热灯。
 Heat lamp for dermal perm.

这……是什么？
 What... is this?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
皮肤烫卷用的加热灯。它多半能让使用者把皱纹折成自认美观的形状，或是让皮肤的纹理更为细致。
 Heat lamp for dermal perm. It likely allows for its users to fold wrinkles into shapes they deem aesthetic, or allow them to refine the grains of their skin.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
啊哈……可是为什么？为了什么……？
 Aha... But why? For what...?
texts.speaker:
布布
 Pwie

texts.text:
默尔索讲解的时候，加热灯下压着的一本说明手册引起了我的注意。
 As Meursault explained, an information pamphlet tucked under the heat lamp caught my eye.

我刚把它拿起来，以实玛利就已经站到了我面前，手伸出来，像是在等着接什么东西。
 The instant I picked it up, Ishmael was in front of me with her hand jut out like she was waiting to receive something.

您要看那个吗，但丁？
 Gonna read that, Dante?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<呃……要吧……？不过……你先看也行，我不介意。>
 <Uh... Yeah...? But... You can read it first, I don't mind.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我投降了——我是说，我把手册递给了以实玛利。
 I surrendered—I mean, I handed the pamphlet over to Ishmael.

唔，我看看……在接受皮肤烫卷的过程中，客人的形态会变成“护理中顾客”，与他人无从分辨……啊哈！所以他们才都戴着那种防毒面具……
 Hmm, let's see... While undergoing the dermal perm procedure, the client's form assumes that of a "procedure customer," and becomes indistinguishable from others... Aha! So that's why they're all wearing those gas masks...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
这是她进来之后最放松的一次了。
 This is the most at ease she's been ever since we entered here.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<是、是啊……>
 <Y-yeah...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante
